name: Custom Shape Wooden Wobbly Fridge Magnet
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy and durable structure.
    - Crafted with 3mm thick wooden layers, giving the product a solid feel and a nice dimensional look.
    - Features a wood back/base, adding warmth and a handmade-style appearance.
    - Includes a metal rotating mechanism that allows the movable part to wobble smoothly.
    - Comes with strong disc magnets on the back for secure attachment to refrigerators and other magnetic surfaces.
    - Designed with a layered structure that combines durability, decorative appeal, and playful movement.
    - Suitable for long-term display as both a personalized keepsake and a functional fridge magnet.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size: 3 x 3 in ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm
    - Total product thickness: approximately 2.7 cm
    - Disc magnet size: Ø 1 cm
    - Disc magnet thickness: 3mm
    - Rotating mechanism size:
             +) Diameter: 0.5 cm ~ 0.197 in
             +) Thickness: 0.25 cm ~ 0.1 in
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Detailed layer breakdown:
             +) Front Piece – Layer 1: No printing
             +) Front Piece – Layer 2: 1-sided printing
             +) Rotating Piece 1 and 2: 1-sided printing
             +) Locking Pin: 1-sided printing
             +) Base – Layer 1: No printing
             +) Base – Layer 2: 1-sided printing
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative fridge magnet with a fun wobbly moving effect.
    - The movable body part is connected with a rotating mechanism, creating playful motion when touched.
    - Strong magnets help the product stay attached securely to: refrigerators, magnetic boards, lockers, filing cabinets, and other metal surfaces.
    - Works well as both a personalized decoration and a small keepsake gift.
    - Ideal for displaying in kitchens, offices, classrooms, dorm rooms, or pet corners.
    - Can be customized with pet-themed designs, names, characters, or cute illustrations.
    - Compact size makes it easy to display without taking up much space.
    - Great for adding a fun and personalized touch to everyday spaces.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for pet lovers and animal-themed gift ideas.
    - A cute gift choice for dog moms, dog dads, cat lovers, and pet families.
    - Great for birthdays, holidays, Christmas, and housewarming gifts.
    - Ideal as a personalized keepsake with custom names or character artwork.
    - A lovely gift for friends, family members, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Suitable for anyone who enjoys cute, custom, and playful home decorations.
    - A charming small gift for decorating kitchens, workspaces, and magnetic display areas.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Wobbly Fridge Magnet

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
